items.title: Red Holloway interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: my first gig on the road was with Roosevelt Sykes for a year, 1948. I went all over the U.S. with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, and so the thing is, it’s something that you have to feel. And I was around more blues players. In fact, my mother and Roosevelt Sykes went to school together. And my first gig on the road was with Roosevelt Sykes for a year, 1948. I went all over the U.S. © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-
with him. So now when you’re playing the blues every night, you got to, you can’t help but know the blues, and feel the blues. So that was one of the, that’s really how I got started, and that’s—
